artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: The DB-i-7 record: script hash, household digest (equal to round 117 and round 118), the three role digests, one GET listed (NewPortfolio with isActive true, HTTP 200, 3040 rows, id key id), the file path and sha256 of the private 2xx body, the presence flags of the three roles in that body, the two comparisons with their field names, counts and boolean values (none), the missing-account finding (found in GET 1), the credential verdict ACCEPTED, reads and basis words. Counts, digests, field names and verdict words only. No AWS write, no push, no deploy.

The one probe script, hashed in the record. It makes at most three paced GETs of the two Portfolio account endpoints named by the order, with no retry and a stop on any non-2xx; it reads the token through the estate's Secrets Manager loader only; it holds no AWS write call, names no other firm, and writes no token. Run once from the worktree; the self-test was run offline before the run.
One row appended as bytes, IRPT_DASHBD-D2-W307-S1 (OBSERVATION, INERT): the GET's header names were re-cased by the request builder. Form only; no client value.

acceptance.criterion_verbatim: `DBI119-1-AC1` -- the record is complete and carries no identifier; the script is a tracked file hashed as recorded with no AWS write call and no other firm's name; the household and the three role digests equal the checker's recompute from round 118's record and the private Q3 body; 1 to 3 gets are listed in the order above, each a 2xx saved as a private file hashed as recorded (a failed get only as the last), `gets_made` and `vendor_calls` equal to the count, and a later get only while the missing account was still not found; each get's presence flags equal the checker's recount from the saved body with the recorded id key; each comparison (path counts, relevant and exclusion-type path lists, boolean values, verdict) equals the checker's recompute from the records found in the saved bodies; `missing_account_found` and the credential verdict equal the recount; no write to AWS, no push, no deploy. Base: FAIL (no record).

Credential ACCEPTED and missing_account_found true equal the recount (2 of 2). Script sha256, household digest and the three role digests equal the checker's recompute (the checker's script, household and role checks all pass; no separate count).
